The [[Guardian of Whispers]] guards the entrance to the innermost area of the Chantry of Secrets. That area is only accessible after completion of the [[Nightfall campaign]] (that is, the [[Abaddon's Gate]] mission), and contains the statue of the [[Goddess of Truth]]. [[Kneel]]ing at that statue summons the [[Seer of Truth]], the goddess' avatar, which in turn grants access to the [[Domain of Anguish]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Chantry of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
Outside the gate, in the general area:
:''"The area behind these doors is not yet ready for public access."''
:'''{{yes}} I would like to pay my respects to the new god [[Kormir]].''' (After completion of Abaddon's Gate.)
::''"Oh, so you know of the new statue? Well, I guess you can come in to sneak a peak. {{sic|Should be 'peek'}} Let me know when you're ready."
::;{{yes}} I am ready.
::;{{no|ingame}} I am not ready.

Inside the gate, in the inner area:
:''"I will let you pass. Tell me when you're ready."''
:;{{yes}} I am ready.
:;{{no|ingame}} I am not ready.
